text:
sam: CI is failing on infra repo — helm step in the gha workflow keeps failing and the PR is blocked by the required 'deploy/helm' check. digging into the logs now.
maria: link? which run id? can you paste snippet
sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/actions/runs/9876543210 (job: deploy-helm)
logs show secret mount errors and then helm --atomic rollback
ash: fyi we pushed a new ephemeral-runner image last week that shrank the rootfs a bit (switched to distroless->alpine slim). could be running out of disk on /var/lib/kubelet
ash: also seeing a lot of concurrent PRs trying to deploy to the same namespace. concurrency/locking might be racy.
ash: log snippet:
```
Error: UPGRADE FAILED: failed to create subPathPath: mkdir /var/lib/kubelet/pods/abcde/volumes/kubernetes.io~secret/my-secret: no space left on device
mounting secret "my-secret" into pod "app-deploy-foo-123" failed: failed to sync secret
Helm install (atomic) failed, performing rollback
```
kai: that exact no space error usually means the node ephemeral storage watermark hit. On GKE we saw kubelet evicting and subpath mkdirs failing. Could be autoscaler churn too.
maria: is this only in staging? or prod too? the run you linked is for staging cluster-qa.
sam: only staging so far. but the GH workflow uses the same runner pool labels across envs.
ash: quick repro idea: rerun job on a bigger runner label or force a new ephemeral node. otherwise change helm step to non-atomic to avoid rollback noise but that'll leave partial state.
kai: concurrency is also a smell — two PRs can both run helm upgrade on same release concurrently. We should add a GHA concurrency group keyed by release name. for now, maybe add `concurrency: group: infra-helm-${{ github.ref }}`
maria: there was also a cache-restore step (s3) that sometimes stalls the job for ~2-3min before timing out — could be causing kube creds to be delayed and the deployment window to overlap with node churn.
sam: good point. logs show cache restore 404 then retry, job waits. here's that snippet:
```
Restore cache: found 0 cache entries
S3 GET https://cache.redwood-infra.s3.amazonaws.com/... 404
Retrying in 15s
```
devops-bot: [alert] gke-nodepool/ephemeral-small at 85% disk usage in us-west1-staging (last check 2m ago)
ash: action items: 1) revert ephemeral-runner image change (or bump runner disk) 2) add concurrency locking to helm workflow 3) add preflight check to fail fast when node ephemeral storage > 75% 4) temporary: re-run blocked PRs on a bigger runner label
sam: I'll open infra PR to bump ephemeral-runner disk to 50Gi and add the preflight check. will also add the concurrency key for helm jobs.
maria: I'll re-run the two blocked PRs on a larger runner label now and monitor.
kai: also add a small waiting backoff after cache-restore failure to avoid immediate overlapping deploy windows (15s -> 60s). small mitigation.
sam: thanks. anyone want to own revert of the runner image? feels safer to revert until we confirm disk sizing in AMI build.
ash: i'll take the revert PR, will include notes about the disk regression and link packer build.
sam: sweet. will post updates here when PRs merge and when the reruns succeed. :thumbsup:
